data.raw_text:
I almost never post about personal meals. Tonight is a most worthy exception.

19 years ago in October, I was part of a radio debate on the Pete Wilson show (not the Governor) in San Francisco in support of Proposition 90, the post-Kelo eminent domain and regulatory takings initiative. ( @StevenGreenhut will remember this one.) After the debate, I used the excuse of avoiding Bay Area rush-hour traffic to have one of the best stateside meals I’ve ever had not cooked by my grandmother or Lori. I went to the iconic Scoma’s on the San Francisco waterfront, and had an absolutely incredible meal of Clams Bordelaise, sourdough bread, and their famous tiramisu for dessert. 52 fresh Manila clams. Incredible.

Tonight, after having found a remarkable bargain on quality clams in a most unlikely location outside Nashville, I re-created that most memorable meal. Lori’s homemade sourdough was more than equal to the best San Francisco Francisco can offer. My efforts to emulate Scoma’s recipe was a great success…with one or two know worthy additions to personal taste. Add in a pound or more of butter, and culinary bliss. And 54 clams this time…a new personal record!

Oh, and because I have the most wonderful and incredible wife in the world, my Christmas tiramisu will be even better than Scoma’s. Lori has lovingly perfected her own version, which with absolutely no disrespect to one of the great oceanside restaurants of the West Coast, truly surpasses the original. 

it may be a while before I post on food again, because this combination is gonna be awfully hard to beat.
